variant.author: BlueWaveXIV
variant.changelog:
Removed fixed Free Market Price. Only after confirming no eligible live competitors, AutoList uses a reliable Materia completed-sale average, then Japan if Materia data is unavailable or unreliable; otherwise it leaves the item unlisted.
Requires recent uploads and at least three matching-quality sales in four days after outlier filtering. Minimum prices, HQ/NQ rules and own-retainer protection remain; historical averages are not undercut.
Asynchronous bounded requests, cancellation and short-lived historical caching keep lookups responsive. Old fixed-price settings are dropped on save without losing approvals or other rules. AutoRefresh remains competitor-only.
All 276 automated checks pass. Native workflow timing, price suitability and settlement remain for in-game testing.
